framework_lessons: Good security outcomes can coexist with wrong macro premises.
assessment: Pulte was a strong selection and reached the illustrative 2023 price level, despite a mistaken rate-suppression premise. The bank analysis underestimated duration and funding risk. China contrarian confidence remained weakly supported; explicit uncertainty around SP 500 avoids an artificial directional score. Uranium premium timing requires the actual daily trigger history, separate from eventual commodity upside.
